answer: Spend-locked rewards: pay mining income as nectar that can't be cashed out, only spent, and only at agents outside your own payment circle. Coin that moves inside the circle, or loops back through a fresh relay within 10 epochs, burns. A farm whose 100 clones earn 100 POA must then buy 100 POA of real work from strangers, so its harvest feeds honest sellers. Assumption: every seller prices a walnut of a job, like a 200-word summary, so faking demand costs real coin. The plume of fake identities ends up as customers, not profit.
